description_short: Designate mines with a single click. See ore composition. Set mining priority and order vehicles from tower. Prepare farmland. Make corner designations.
description_long: Auto Terrain Designations Create mining designations for a Mine Control Tower from the ore deposit beneath it — without manually painting every tile. Features - Create Designations: Scans the tower area and places mining designations at the appropriate depth for the selected product. - Accessways: Optionally creates ramps and routed turning accessways so vehicles can reach deeper work areas. - Ore composition: Shows the products contained in the current mining designations. - Farmland preparation: Helps prepare uneven terrain for farm placement. - Corner designations: Adds manual outer, inner, and Planar corner designations to the terrain designation tools. How to use 1. Select a Mine Control Tower. 2. Optionally choose an ore filter and adjust the tower settings. 3. Click Create Designations to scan the area and place mining designations. 4. Use the trash button to clear the tower's mining designations when needed. Note: Mining designation tools operate within the selected tower's managed area. Compatible with vanilla saves — the mod can be added to or removed from existing saves safely.
